messages:
sam-release: kicking off engine quant/kernel rollout for v1.4.0 this window. will do 5% canary, then 25, then 100. deploybot will handle slicing. pls ack if blocked. :eyes:
deploy-bot: starting rollout job run-3612345678. plan: canary=5%, regions=[us-east-1,eu-west-1], prereqs=smoke+perf. command: ```/deploy engine:1.4.0 --bundle quant-kernel-1.4.0 --canary 5 --regions us-east-1,eu-west-1```
kyle-runtime: quick note — staging showed intermittent kv-cache eviction on p99 for 20s during perf smoke earlier. repro steps attached in last convo.
maya-eng: saw that too, but only in sim with long prompts. baseline image had different kernel args. might be config drift.
tj-oncall: tagging @nora-sre in case this crosses service SLOs. what's rollback criteria?
sam-release: rollback if canary p99 latency increases >30% for >10m or error rate >0.5% absolute. also manual rollback if heap/eviction observed.
kyle-runtime: recommended temporary pin if canary flaps: deploybot pin TTL=2h, then we investigate.
maya-eng: agree. also suggest enabling kv cache telemetry flag for canary to get detailed metrics: `runtime.kv.debug=true` (only for canary).
deploy-bot: can set pin: ```/pin engine:1.3.9 --until +2h --reason "canary pin due to kv-eviction"``` — need an approver.
tj-oncall: approved for safety pin if canary meets rollback thresholds. I'll watch.
sam-release: ok, do the initial 5% canary. ops: run staged rollout script, then report smoke/telemetry link here.
deploy-bot: canary started (5%) — jobs launched in us-east-1 and eu-west-1. smoke target: gen throughput, p50/p95/p99, kv-evict count.
(5m later) kyle-runtime: smoke shows p95 up ~8%, p99 up ~28% in eu-west-1, kv-evict=3 samples in last 4m, not yet at rollback thresholds but trending.
maya-eng: tagging logs: ```runtime.kv: eviction_count=3, last_eviction=2026-03-20T22:39:10Z``` — looks like memory pressure.
tj-oncall: holding 25% step for 15m to watch. if it climbs, we'll pin.
(10m later) kyle-runtime: p99 spike now 36% in eu-west-1, kv-evict increased to 7 in 6m. recommend pin and stop rollout.
sam-release: agreed. enact pin and rollback any bounced canary.
deploy-bot: executing pin and halt: ```/pin engine:1.3.9 --until +2h --reason "p99 spike + kv-evict during canary" && /abort-rollout run-3612345678``` — done. pin id=pin-3612345685.
tj-oncall: thanks. I'm standing by to rollback if pin fails.
nora-sre: will open incident ticket for postmortem and attach canary telemetry. priority: high for runtime regressions.
maya-eng: quick checklist for next steps: 1) reproduce locally with identical kernel args, 2) add extra kv mem headroom, 3) run extended smoke with long prompt traces.
sam-release: note for release notes: remove v1.4.0 from changelog until followup, add note about rolling back due to cache regressions. update draft: "Rollout paused: kernel/quant v1.4.0 — canary p99 regression observed; investigating kv cache behavior."
nora-sre: I posted initial ticket INC-36123457 and linked trace. assigning to kyle/maya.
kyle-runtime: will start bisect on kernel commit range and test with older kv config. ETA 2h.
(2m later) sam-release: thanks team. we'll reattempt after fix + replayed smoke. will update release notes and rerun canary once green. :thumbsup:
